speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Granulation tissue formation following tympanoplasty.

The microscopic exam and otoscopy images confirm the presence of vascular, fleshy tissue filling the middle ear space, which is compressing the nerve endings and causing your shooting pain and sensitivity to earrings. This is a common complication after ear surgery that typically requires surgical removal of the granulation tissue.
